children: Personalis said Tempus made an irrevocable election for approximately $600 million in cash consideration as part of their proposed merger.
Tempus set the Cash Share Number at 36,923,077 Personalis shares, subject to possible reduction under the merger agreement.
Absent adjustment, about 38.6% of each eligible holder’s shares are expected to receive $16.25 per share in cash; remaining shares receive Tempus Class A stock.
The final cash fraction and exchange ratio will be calculated before closing; the transaction remains subject to Personalis stockholder approval and other customary conditions.
